limitations.statement: A measure that exists only on generated takes (the talker's introspection, long-form seams) has no N2 to confirm on: a codec round trip samples no token and joins no segment, so its fit and confirmation negatives are N3 alone (audit section 5.7), the two splits of config/audio-qc-calibration-takes.json disjoint by family, speaker and script. N3 carries no defect labels, so a flag rate f bounds the false-alarm rate only as f / (1 - pi_max), where pi_max is the largest defect prevalence admitted (section 5.1). Each language stratum needs at least 60 scored families in each split (the calibration split plans 80 per language).

strata.name: language
strata.reason: The talker's per-step distribution follows each language's text tokens and prosody (its entropy, where it stops, and the cycles its pauses and repeated syllables form), so each language is its own clean distribution.
